relations.myth: Flood survivors become the first Sumpall
relations.note: Popular retellings claim Trentren helped transform flood victims into Sumpall; this derives from modern comparative reconstruction.

relations.myth: Flood survivors become the first Sumpall
relations.note: Popular retellings claim Kaikai helped transform flood victims into Sumpall; no early primary narrative attests this genealogy.
A Botxolwe community publication overlaps this local aquatic divinity with Augusta’s definition of Shompallwe.
Late regional discussions align female Sumpall with the Blue Maiden, without narrating them as separate interacting beings.
